title: fragaria elatior var. muricata
intro: Fragaria elatior var. muricata, commonly known as Wood's cranberry or American cranberry, is a type of wild cranberry plant native to North America. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include supporting urinary tract health and providing antioxidant properties that may help protect against cell damage and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Fragaria elatior var. muricata include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, making it a potential natural remedy for conditions such as urinary tract infections and skin irritations. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, anthocyanins, and other polyphenolic compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
